SSE Client

Consumes Server-Sent Events streams over HTTP/1.1 (with optional TLS). Uses CPS procs for clean, sequential async code. Supports automatic gzip decompression of compressed SSE streams.

Usage: let client = await connectSse("example.com", 443, "/events", useTls = true) while not client.reader.atEof: let event = await client.readEvent() echo event.eventType, ": ", event.data
